headline: Novara Electronics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Novara Electronics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Gdansk. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Novara Electronics wins quality award from industry association
body: Novara Electronics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Novara Electronics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Novara Electronics reported revenue growth of 21% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Novara Electronics, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Novara Electronics have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.

headline: Court freezes assets of Novara Electronics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Novara Electronics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Novara Electronics Gdansk facility
body: Workers at the Gdansk facility of Novara Electronics voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Novara Electronics publishes annual sustainability report
body: Novara Electronics released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Data breach at Novara Electronics exposes customer records
body: Novara Electronics disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.
